summary.motive: Punish aggressive interior slants by trapping the penetrating lineman under complete Buck Sweep disguise.
summary.whyItWorks: The full sweep sell sends every perimeter defender wide while the trap converts the slant's own momentum into a kicked-open B-gap.
summary.failureMode: The tackle two-gaps instead of slanting, or linebackers play slow-to-the-ball discipline and meet the gut before the lead block lands.

beats.title: 1. The Sweep Footwork Sell
beats.text: The quarterback pivots off the Buck Sweep mesh while both guards show their signature pull steps and B presses the edge — every perimeter trigger fires.

beats.title: 2. The Trap Springs
beats.text: The slanting 3-tech penetrates himself into the trap as the guard whirs back and kicks him out of the very gap he was shooting.

beats.title: 3. Downhill Through the B-Gap
beats.text: The wing takes the hidden exchange and hits the vacated seam full speed behind the redirecting lead guard, who buries the filling linebacker.

beats.title: 4. The Perimeter Still Sold
beats.text: The force corner and safety are still chasing the sweep fake at the numbers while the gut gains vertically between the hashes.

relations.tell: The playside guard pulls flat then reverses direction mid-step — true sweep pullers never come back to the interior.
